objectives.label: The bottom number tells how many equal pieces the whole is cut into
objectives.demonstrated_when: Learner says in their own words that the denominator is the number of equal pieces of the whole.
objectives.not_enough: Naming the numbers without saying what they mean.

objectives.label: A fair comparison needs wholes of the same size and equal pieces
objectives.demonstrated_when: Learner states that the bars (wholes) are the same size, or that the pieces within a bar must be equal.
objectives.not_enough: Comparing pieces without mentioning the whole.

objectives.label: More pieces of the same whole means smaller pieces, so 1/4 is smaller than 1/3
objectives.demonstrated_when: Learner links more pieces to smaller pieces and concludes 1/3 is bigger than 1/4.
objectives.not_enough: "It's cut into more pieces" alone, or the right answer with no reason.

misconceptions.label: Thinks 1/4 is bigger than 1/3 because 4 is bigger than 3
Thinks 1/3 and 1/4 are equal because both have one piece
Calls unequal pieces thirds or fourths
